text_block_list.text:
Writing her own legend as she goes,
Мэдзиро Райан
surpasses the superstar
Oguri Cap and claims
victory!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In her post-race interview, she declares
that her
glorious victory is all thanks to
her fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the wake of her defeat, Огури Кэп's

captivation with Мэдзиро Райан's racing
leads her to
tell Ryan that she wants to
continue racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан has grown so much that
she's begun
to charm even the superstar
racers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
